name: Accelerated Career Awareness Program (ACAP)
what_you_do: A week on campus learning about accounting jobs. You tour local firms that do accounting. You practice interviews, meeting people, public speaking and college planning.
who_can_apply: Qualified high school sophomores, juniors and seniors. Students who are often left out are encouraged to apply. You must be at least 14 to live on campus. No experience needed.
pay_detail: Tuition is free for accepted students. A $25 non-refundable registration fee holds your spot. You pay your own travel to Pittsburgh.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran July 26 to 31, 2026. The page listed no application deadline. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Send the application on the program page with at least two letters of support from counselors or teachers. If you are accepted, sign up and pay the $25 fee. Contact summercamps@pointpark.edu or 412-392-3456.
notes: Run with the National Association of Black Accountants (NABA). Residents must be in their rooms by 10 pm. The page showed the 2025 schedule.
org: Point Park University (Rowland School of Business)
